messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The customer has to manually draft letters for overdue claims, which is overwhelming.
  quote: can we automate letters for overdue claims? I’m swamped with manual drafting.
- problem: The claim progress notification messages have not been activated yet.
  quote: We’re still waiting on those claim progress messages to go live — the team’s keen to get policyholders auto-notified at key stages.
- problem: They lack automatic claim progress notifications via SMS and email.
  quote: we really need claim progress messages to go out via ... to policyholders automatically.
- problem: Policyholders are not receiving automatic updates when their claim progresses to the next stage.
  quote: our policyholders keep asking why they don’t get automatic updates when their claim moves to the next stage... why they aren’t getting automatic alerts when their claim status changes
- problem: The user cannot customize the letters sent to policyholders for different claim types.
  quote: Perfect. One last thing — are we able to customize the letters sent to policyholders for specific claim types?
- problem: Policyholders are unsure when they will receive updates during their claim process.
  quote: we’ve got a few policyholders asking when they’ll get updates during their claim process. Is there a way to automate those messages?
- problem: The customer has to manually send policyholder communications.
  quote: Quick question — can we get policyholder comms automated too? It’s another manual task.
- problem: The customer is unsure if claim progress messages via SMS and email will be delivered on schedule.
  quote: are we still on track for claim progress messages via SMS and email by Q1 2027?...Our policyholders are expecting updates at key milestones.
